text:
nina: hi team, new eng on platform. quick qabout sandbox API keys and quotas — planning a short CI-driven smoke that will hit about 40 rps for 3 minutes, responses ~600 tokens. what's safe to run without hitting sandbox rate limits?

devex: welcome! default sandbox quotas are conservative (order 50-100 reqs/min depending on account). token throughput and concurrent connections also limited. for short bursts you're usually fine, but file a quota request if you want buffer.

sam: FYI defaults vary by org. you can create an ephemeral key from Console that expires in 2-4 hours for CI. use minimal scopes and rotate.

nina: cool. is there a form to request a temp bump or IP allowlist?

infra-ops: yup. Console -> Usage -> Quota Requests. add project id, time window, desired rps, CIDR if you want allowlist. we can manually approve short windows for tests.

onboarding-bot: checklist: "Request sandbox quota" pending for @nina.

nina: thanks, i submitted for project-alpha (window 1763563600-1763564400 UTC) targeting 120 rps and included CIDR.

devex: i'll attach a short alert and watch the project during the window. remember to set REDWOOD_API_KEY in CI and avoid printing it in logs.

sam: also cap max_tokens in requests to avoid surprises. example payload: {"model":"open-redwood-1-small","input":"...","max_tokens":600}.

nina: awesome, appreciate the help!
